description: This file is a shell script used as a test suite for the Git trace2 facility. It defines multiple test cases to verify trace event capturing, nested process spawning, configuration listing, environment variables, and redaction features in the trace2 instrumentation.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success; executes commands and compares output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes, for cleanup or verification.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global git configuration for testing.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers, used to create filenames.
